We specialize in traditional homemade dishes—noodles, dumplings, broths, and curries—made fresh daily with time-honored recipes. This is comfort food done right: genuine flavors, welcoming atmosphere, and the kind of Asian cooking that tastes like it came from a home kitchen, because that's exactly where these recipes come from. 107 Taste is a restaurant that brings the comforting flavors of home-cooked Asian cuisine with a creative twist. Inspired by the diverse culinary traditions of East Asia, Chef Yu Bi from Sichuan crafts each dish with passion, blending authentic recipes with bold innovations. Our specialties include sizzling hot wok noodles, rich and aromatic ramen slow brined for eight hours, and a variety of authentic bites that will delight your taste buds. Set in a beautifully designed space with chic, neutral décor, 107 Taste offers a warm and inviting atmosphere where every meal feels special.

restaurants.description: Located in the heart of Miami Lakes, 1910 Restaurant & Bar is a family-owned restaurant inspired by the elegance and glamour of the 1910 era, offering a unique international fusion of steakhouse, seafood, Italian, Cuban, Latin, and American cuisine. Known for its charcoal-grilled specialties, wood-fired pizzas, handmade pastas, premium steaks, and fresh seafood, 1910 has quickly become one of the area’s most celebrated dining destinations. Guests enjoy an upscale yet welcoming atmosphere featuring live violin and saxophone performances, soft live music, a full-service bar, elegant indoor dining, and a beautiful outdoor patio. With experienced chefs, exceptional hospitality, and a passion for culinary excellence, 1910 Restaurant & Bar delivers an unforgettable dining experience that embodies The Art of Dining.

restaurants.description: The 94th Aero Squadron Restaurant in Miami offers a distinctive dining experience that combines aviation history with a diverse menu. Overlooking the runway of Miami International Airport, guests can enjoy views of planes taking off and landing, with headphones available at each table to listen to live air traffic control communications. The restaurant's design emulates a World War I-era French farmhouse, complete with vintage military memorabilia, providing a unique and immersive atmosphere. The menu features a variety of American and international dishes, including steakhouse classics, seafood, and pasta. The restaurant also offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and happy hour services.

restaurants.description: Located in the historic Art Deco District, A Fish Called Avalon specializes in seafood with tropical influences. Enjoy your meal in our beautiful dining room, which has floor to ceiling windows with views of world-famous Ocean Drive. Dine on our terrace, where live music and ocean breezes set a sophisticated and authentic South Beach experience. The dinner menu includes a raw bar, as well as macadamia-crusted snapper and an orzo seafood paella among many other seafood bestsellers. Other non-seafood options include ribeye, vegetarian pasta, and a free-range citrus chicken. There is a full bar and an award-winning wine list. Dinner Hours: 5:00 - to 10:30 pm Mon-Wed & 5:00 - to 11:00 pm Thu-Sun Happy Hour: 3:00 to 7:00 pm Daily Enjoy luscious libations and a selection of some signature appetizers at the bar, seven days a week from 3:00 to 7:00 p.m. Live music daily. Reservations are highly suggested. Culinary excellence Since 1989. Public parking garage located on 7th Street between Washington and Collins Avenue. Valet Parking Option - 3 hours for $10.

restaurants.name: A Pasta Bar
restaurants.description: A Pasta Bar brings its acclaimed SoHo concept to Miami Beach’s Sunset Harbour neighborhood, offering a contemporary Italian dining experience centered around handmade pasta and an immersive open-kitchen design. Built around a striking central island kitchen and 20-seat chef’s counter, the restaurant invites guests into the heart of the culinary process, where fresh pasta is crafted daily and finished with precision in full view of the dining room. The menu blends Italian tradition with modern influences, featuring signature pastas, crudo selections, wood-grilled meats, seasonal seafood, and a curated five-course pasta tasting experience designed for sharing. Guests can also enjoy a Milanese-style aperitivo hour, inventive Italian-inspired cocktails, and an exclusively Italian wine list. Designed with rich materials, vintage Italian furnishings, and a vibrant indoor-outdoor atmosphere, A Pasta Bar offers a lively yet refined dining destination in the heart of Sunset Harbour.

restaurants.description: Located in Miami Beach's South of Fifth neighborhood, Abbale Telavivian Kitchen is a family-run restaurant inspired by the café's of Tel Aviv. The menu features a selection of health-conscious ethnic dishes accented with fresh, local ingredients, influenced by the flavors of Israel, Turkey, Colombia and Greece. From a variety of Salatim to Shakshuka, whole Branzino to grilled lamb chops and oven-baked baby cauliflower, there are plenty of flavorful options to choose from. A partnership between chef Samuel Gorenstein and Omer Horev, founder of Pura Vida Miami, Abbale serves lunch, dinner and brunch on Sundays in an intimate and casual dining atmosphere.

Perched on the 25th floor, offering stunning views of Biscayne Bay, Enjoy our terrace or private dining for a memorable experience, perfect for any occasion. Experience unparalleled cuisine, panoramic views and an unmatched ambience at ADRIFT Mare. ADRIFT Mare brings together the elegance of the French Riviera, the laid back vibe of the Balearic islands, the vibrancy of fresh Italian produce, warm Levant hospitality and the gentle rhythm of the Greek Isles.

restaurants.description: Welcome to Aguasal, where the vibrant spirit of Miami meets the allure of the Mediterranean. Brought to you by the award-winning José Andrés Group, our signature restaurant offers a seaside celebration of coastal flavors—blending inspirations from Miami, Majorca and Mykonos. Here, Florida’s rich bounty is elevated through time-honored preparations, fragrant herbs, and signature bites all complemented by handcrafted beverages. A laid-back, luxe coastal ethos infuses everything we do, creating an unforgettable dining experience.

restaurants.description: Amazónico Miami brings the pulse of Latin America to the heart of Brickell with a three-story dining and nightlife experience designed to transport guests into a world of tropical glamour, elevated cuisine, and nonstop energy. Inspired by the richness of the Amazon rainforest and the vibrant spirit of 1970s Rio de Janeiro, Amazónico blends immersive design, world-class hospitality, and globally influenced Latin American flavors into one of Miami’s most sought-after destinations. From the moment guests arrive, they are surrounded by lush greenery, woven textures, volcanic stone, dramatic lighting, and curated music that evolves throughout the night. The ground-floor restaurant offers an open-kitchen concept where diners can experience the theater of live-fire cooking, fresh seafood, premium meats, and vibrant Amazon-inspired dishes while live jazz, bossa nova, and Cuban rhythms create an unforgettable atmosphere. Upstairs, the Bar & Lounge transforms the experience into a high-energy social escape, featuring a signature sushi counter, expertly crafted tropical cocktails, mirrored ceilings, and resident DJs alongside live percussion performances. Every detail is designed to blur the line between fine dining and nightlife, making Amazónico equally ideal for intimate dinners, celebratory evenings, and late-night experiences. Crowning the venue is its iconic rooftop, an open-air destination that captures the electric spirit of Miami after dark. With skyline views, a dramatic peacock-inspired bar, immersive lighting, and a music-driven ambiance, the rooftop delivers an effortlessly sophisticated setting for cocktails, private events, and unforgettable nights in Brickell. As the first U.S. location of the internationally acclaimed Amazónico brand — with celebrated venues in Madrid, London, Dubai, and Monte Carlo — Amazónico Miami has quickly established itself as a premier destination where luxury dining, entertainment, and culture converge under one roof.

restaurants.description: Andrés Carne de Res, the iconic Colombian restaurant has arrived in the U.S. with its vibrant location on Lincoln Road in Miami Beach. Established by Chef Andrés Jaramillo in 1982, this celebrated eatery presents a menu featuring beloved dishes like Lomo al Trapo and Shrimp Encocado, alongside a range of refreshing cocktails. The expansive 10,000-square-foot space is beautifully decorated with colorful murals and handcrafted details, providing a lively atmosphere enhanced by exciting live music and entertainment. Guests can also browse the gift shop for unique, handcrafted Colombian treasures. The restaurant welcomes diners Sunday to Wednesday from noon to 11 p.m. and Thursday to Saturday from noon to 2 a.m.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: Weekend brunch and Thursday through Saturday lunch are both $40, while dinner runs $65 Tuesday through Sunday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: From the impressive Latin American spread, go for the chilled shrimp salad over a crunchy tostada or the grilled octopus skewers marinated in Peruvian anticuchera sauce. The slow-cooked marinated pork leg and white coconut macaroons with dulce de leche also have our attention.

restaurants.description: Standing out in the sea of critically-acclaimed restaurants and bars that call Miami Beach home is no small task, but Azabu Miami Beach manages to do exactly that. A Unique Dining Experience in the Heart of Miami Beach The first thing to know about Azabu Miami Beach is that it’s unlike any other restaurant or bar in the city, offering a spectrum of experiences under a single, stylish roof. There are three separate but connected spaces within the venue, each one united by incredible food, drinks, and service. First is the full-service dining room, where diners can take a front-row seat to the chefs’ culinary prowess thanks to the large, open kitchen. Just steps beyond the dining room is The Den, a hidden gem where Tokyo-trained sushi chefs craft some of the best sashimi and sushi in Miami. Finally, Bar Azabu is the venue’s classic cocktail bar, serving the best sakes in the world and more than 40 different imported whiskeys. Azabu Miami Beach also hosts private events and provides off-site catering, going above and beyond to deliver on their signature omotenashi promise.

restaurants.description: At Bagatelle Miami River, the spirit of the French Riviera comes alive through a blend of sophistication and playful elegance. Inspired by St. Tropez, the waterfront space is filled with natural light, lush greenery, and curated French details, from artwork to cabanas, creating a transportive escape along the Miami River. Bagatelle comes to life from day into night with refined dinner service, lively evenings, and the iconic Bagatelle Sundays, featuring a rotating DJ lineup that sets the tone for an elevated brunch-to-party experience. Wednesday - Saturday, as the sun begins to set, guests are invited to discover Sunset Offerings along the river. Sunset Hour is a relaxed early-evening ritual at the outdoor bar, featuring $2 oysters, seafood bites, champagne by the glass, and signature cocktails. For those seeking a seated dining experience, Sunset Dinner offers a three-course pre-fixe menu of signature favorites with optional wine pairings. Whether dining indoors, enjoying al fresco river views, or gathering for brunch and late-night energy, Bagatelle Miami River delivers a vibrant, ever-evolving experience that captures Miami’s global spirit with the charm of the South of France. Dinner: Wednesday & Thursday | 6pm - 1:30am Friday & Saturday | 6pm - 2:30am Sunset Hour - Happy Hour Menu: Wednesday - Saturday | 6pm - 7:30pm Bagatelle Sunday Brunch Sunday | 12pm - 10:30pm

restaurants.description: Baia Beach Club brings the laid-back spirit and effortless sophistication of Mediterranean coastal living to the new Mondrian South Beach, an icon reborn. Baia Beach Club culls together elevated, authentic Food and Beverage offerings, progressive Health and Wellness services and immersive social activities to create a truly modern oasis of taste and tranquility in the heart of South Beach. Within the lush tropical centerpiece of a multi-million-dollar property-wide transformation, club members can indulge in the naturally seamless blend of indoor and outdoor space, public and private areas, recreational and restorative facilities and day and night activity for a truly singular experience that is as chic as it is casual that you’ll enjoy from the early morning late into the night. Enter just off Brickell Avenue onto the breezy canopied terrace where eclectic seating, draping vines and reclaimed barn wood welcome guests to mingle, dine and relax. Happening Thursday through Saturday nights, the new concept is made for birthdays, group nights out, and unforgettable celebrations, with signature food, drinks, and surprise moments that keep the party going. restaurants.description: Welcome to Bayshore Club - built on the historic site known as Dinner Key and part of Miami's oldest neighborhood, Coconut Grove. Originally an island and later connected to the mainland in 1914, Dinner Key received its name for being a beautiful picnic stop while traveling by boat along the coastal waters of the city. In 1918 it became the site of the first continental naval air station in the United States until the end of WWI. Through the 1930’s and 40’s, Dinner Key served as a base for Pan American World Airway’s flying boats, the Sikorsky S41 and S42 (commonly known as Clipper planes). The planes were once housed in the newly restored hangers at Bayshore Club and the original Art Deco airport terminal is now the site Miami City Hall located to the southeast side of the restaurant.

restaurants.description: Beauty and the Butcher, in Coral Gables. Ford, who earned a Michelin star for the critically-acclaimed restaurant Stubborn Seed, will showcase his culinary prowess at Beauty and the Butcher with a menu that will focus on rotating seasonal small plates and a selection of different meats. Beauty and the Butcher is a nod to Ford's relationship with his eldest daughter, Madelynn (the beauty), and himself (the butcher). For more information follow @beautyandthebutchermiami. Beauty & the Butcher features an expansive modern dining room with seating for 160, including 30 seats at the bar, and blends contemporary decor with the comforts of home. A smooth gray-veined quartz bar anchors the space and wraps around a display of dry-aging meats. Warm earth-toned woods and glittering bronze accents are found throughout and tabletops and dining chairs alternate between white quartz, honey and caramel hues. Cozy booths are upholstered in forest green leather and are juxtaposed with artfully-decorated bookshelves. Soft lighting from the room’s brass-toned chandeliers emit an inviting glow that runs through the floor-to-ceiling windows out onto the street corner. Tucked away at the back of the restaurant, a private dining room with seating for up to 30 sitting or 60 cocktail-style allows for intimate private events. The exterior of the restaurant features natural elements including red oak wood and limestone, with bronze metal framing the corner entrance to the restaurant.

restaurants.description: Welcome to Bistro Collins The distinctive new culinary centerpiece of Loews Miami Beach Hotel - a stylish dining destination that exemplifies American coastal bistro cuisine. Inspired by the inviting spirit of bistro culture, here timeless technique blends with the vibrant, locally-driven flavors of Latin America and the Caribbean. The result is an elevated take on beloved classics, alongside fresh, inspired dishes destined to become new favorites. Classic Roots. Coastal Soul. At Bistro Collins, we celebrate the balance of simplicity and creativity. Where thoughtful sourcing, seasonal ingredients and culinary craftsmanship come together on every plate. Dishes like Croque Madame Fritters, classic Steak Tartare and delicate handmade pastas share the table with Roasted Prawns with aji panca, Braised Beef Empanadas and bright island-inspired salads. Refined yet approachable, familiar yet unexpected, our menu pays homage to tradition while embracing the colorful flavors that define Miami’s culinary landscape. Complementing our American coastal bistro cuisine is an imaginative cocktail program, featuring artful mixology that celebrates globally inspired spirits. Whether beginning your stay, indulging in a leisurely evening or soaking in the energy of South Beach, Bistro Collins invites you to savor a dining experience that feels refined, relaxed and undeniably Miami.

restaurants.description: Experience a culinary journey like no other at Bonsai Sushi Bar, a vibrant fusion eatery nestled in the heart of Doral. Our restaurant seamlessly blends the delicate art of Japanese sushi with the bold, spicy flavors of Nikkei and Thai cuisine, all with a Caribbean twist. Step inside and discover a cozy atmosphere where every corner whispers of exotic adventures and flavorful delights. Our mixologists craft an array of exotic cocktails inspired by Caribbean flavors. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional service with a smile.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: This chic sushi and cocktail spot will offer a $40 lunch and a $50 dinner option every day of the week.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Start with the fan favorite Bonsai antojito, a crispy shrimp wrapped in sweet plantain, topped with Neptuno salad, spicy mayo and eel sauce, or go for the bao bun filled with smoked picanha. For entrees, there’s an array of roll options and a beef tenderloin served with rice and veggies for those who want something a little more hearty. Save room for dessert: the tempura cheesecake is delightful.

restaurants.description: Chef Keller’s award-winning French bistro, Bouchon, occupies the historic La Palma building, constructed in 1924, formerly home to one of the longest-standing hotels in the city. The Mediterranean-style exterior with a beautiful central courtyard encompasses the restaurant, designed by long-time Bouchon collaborator Adam D. Tihany of Tihany Design in New York City, who worked on both Bouchon restaurants in Yountville and Las Vegas. The menu offers seasonally changing classic French dishes, such as roast chicken, steak frites, and croque madame. It also includes the signature raw bar, featuring a selection of fruits de mer, complemented by an extensive French and domestic wine list, along with traditional cocktails.

restaurants.description: Boulud Sud is Chef Daniel Boulud’s vibrant celebration of the sun and the sea. Drawing inspiration from the coastal Mediterranean, including France’s Côte d’Azur, Spain, Italy, Greece, Morocco, Tunisia, Lebanon, Israel, and Turkey the menu emphasizes regional flavors, featuring an abundance of fresh vegetables, seafood, grains and herbs. The restaurant has been completely renovated in jewel tones and soft fabrics to create a relaxing and casual atmosphere. Boulud Sud also boasts an exceptional cocktail program that actively pulls from the same seasonal products found on the food menu and Our bar/lounge serves food continuously from noon and features a happy hour from 5 to 8pm (excluding weekends). Situated in the JW Marriott Marquis and across the street from the newly opened Silverspot Theatres, Boulud Sud is conveniently located within walking distance of American Airlines Arena, the Perez Art Museum, Brickell City Centre, and all that Downtown Miami has to offer.

restaurants.description: Bulla began as the brainchild of Carlos Centurion, buzz-creating guru and former owner of Por Fin. He and his team of seasoned restaurateurs set out to create the kind of place that stirs the senses and stimulates the appetite. Inspired by the famous gastrobars in Spain, Bulla was born. Why all the buzz? The bar and open kitchen design set the mood with an energetic vibe. The emphasis is on quality gastronomic creations made with the finest and freshest flavors. With tantalizing tapas, new house specialties every week, hand-crafted cocktails and an impressive wine list, Bulla is the place to go to indulge in a celebration of good taste.

Finish with classic sweets like churros con chocolate and coconut flan. Each menu comes with a complimentary beverage: a mimosa at brunch, a beverage and specialty coffee service at lunch and a choice of cocktail or sangria with dinner.

restaurants.description: Bulla Gastrobar is a lively and modern Spanish restaurant that brings the spirit of a traditional tapas bar to life. Inspired by the energy of Spanish street-side cafés and the joy of shared dining, Bulla offers a menu filled with vibrant, handcrafted tapas, paellas, and seasonal specialties made for gathering and connecting. Each dish is rooted in authentic Spanish flavors and crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients, encouraging guests to experience a little bit of everything. More than just a meal, dining at Bulla is a social experience. The atmosphere is warm and energetic, with an open kitchen and bustling bar that set the stage for spontaneous conversation and culinary discover. It's the perfect place to eat, drink, and share in the true spirit of Spanish hospitality.

restaurants.description: Occasionally, fine wine and exquisite food come together in just the right way. The mundane sensations of time seem to melt into joys of the moment. You need only a good friend for sincere conversation and the delectable flavors we bring to your table here at Bunbury. We started this restaurant with the foundational belief that hard work makes big dreams come to life. Bold Malbecs and symphonic Merlots wash away a long day's stress, while Argentinian style steak, Grandma's classic recipes, "food for wine" like Duck Confit, Brie "Crocante", and eight different kinds of empanadas warm your soul.

restaurants.description: A tribute to Cuba and its Cultural influences. Calle Dragones, already a success in Bogota and Cartagena (Colombia), resembles the street in Havana that bears its name and collides with Calle Zanja, dividing the Chinese neighborhood from the rest of Havana. Originally invented by Chinese migrants brought to Cuba as laborers in the 1850's, Asian Latin cuisine blended Chinese and Caribbean ingredients and cooking techniques. The Cuban Revolution in 1959, however, got in the way and deprived the world to meet what was meant to be today's Cuban cuisine. Many left the island and concentrated in Miami and New York. Havana's Chinatown is still one of the oldest and largest in the Americas.

restaurants.description: Casadonna is a coastal Italian-inspired waterfront restaurant developed in partnership between Groot Hospitality and Tao Group Hospitality. It is housed in the same Mediterranean Revival building as Miami’s historic women’s club, located in the city’s burgeoning Edgewater neighborhood. In fact, the name “Casadonna” is derived from the setting-it is a fusion of Italian words translating to “house of the woman" Riviera-style Italian cooking serves as the heart of Casadonna’s cuisine. The menu features the freshest and finest local and imported products, with signature handcrafted dishes. Plates are based around traditional recipes found in the coastal towns of Naples, Taormina, Bari, Positano, and Gaeta, and each is presented in a contemporary fashion. Bespoke cocktails and an extensive wine list will complement this approach

restaurants.description: Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar: Miami's Taste of Tradition & Twist Born in 1926 inside The Watson Hotel, Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar has always mirrored Miami's pulse. What beg, n as a tropical hideaway grew bolder in 1959, when Cuban newcomers infused the city-and our kitchen-with their rich culinary heritage. Today, this cool, modern spot is the city's go-to place to socialize, grab a craft drink, and indulge ir delicious Cuban-fusion plates. Led by next-gen chefs who blend abuela's secrets with global flair, every bite tells a story-whether it's our award-winning Cuban Sandwich, Yucca-Stuffed Shrimp, or sky-high Pan con Bistec. At the bar, Havana beats on: mojitos bursting with fresh-picked fruit, Floridita-style daiquiris, and the smoky Caballero Old Fashioned keep the fiesta flowing from lunch to late night. History, innovation, community-served hot and shaken cold. Welcome home to Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar, whe e Miami's past meets its delicious, social future.

restaurants.description: Located in the heart of Miami, CLAUDIE restaurant is a celebration of the timeless elegance and charm of the South of France. Inspired by "la cuisine du soleil," made famous by Roger Vergé, our menu showcases vibrant Mediterranean flavors infused with the essence of the Côte d'Azur. We craft dishes using the finest ingredients, blending tradition and creativity in an elevated bistronomy setting. Paired with five-star service and warm hospitality, every moment here is designed to delight. Join us and experience the magic of the South of France, where elegance meets freedom and every bite is unforgettable.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: Savor the South of France with the $40 weekday lunch or the $65 dinner, available Sunday through Thursday,
restaurants.editorial_pick: Lean into lunch vibes with the refreshing heirloom tomato gazpacho with basil foam to start, followed by entrées such as Faroe Island salmon with broccoli and basil-vierge sauce. Dinner includes starters like the traditional Niçoise pissaladière with caramelized onion and anchovy, and entrées such as roasted chicken supreme with artichoke, confit tomato and pancetta. Whatever you do, order the Tropézienne tart filled with bourbon vanilla cream and orange blossom. Enjoy skyline views and bold flavors with Rosa Sky’s $50 Miami Spice menu.

restaurants.description: Since February 2021, the Miami outpost of Michelin-starred and James Beard Award nominated Korean Steakhouse COTE NYC has been serving elevated Korean cuisine in Miami’s Design District. The 5,892-square-foot restaurant combines the bold flavors of Korean barbecue with the classic vibe of an American steakhouse. The result is a fine dining experience featuring top-notch service, world-class ingredients and a show-stopping beverage program. Helmed by executive chef David Shim, COTE’s signature menu items include 45-day, USDA prime dry-aged beef with nutrient-dense, probiotic-rich side dishes; a Butcher’s Feast with chef’s choice of four selected cuts of meat accompanied by an assortment of Korean side dishes; and an elevated Steak Omakase experience. The sleek, intimate, 100+ seat dining area features smokeless state-of-the-art tabletop grills at every table. There is also an elaborate dry-aging room and two private dining rooms. COTE’s 1200+ label wine list was nominated for “Outstanding Wine Program” two consecutive years in a row by the James Beard Foundation and also awarded Florida Sommelier. Other notable awards include the 2022 MICHELIN Guide Florida Star Revelation which recognizes the COTE brand as one of the only two restaurants in the United States with MICHELIN stars in multiple cities.

restaurants.description: The brainchild of two South Florida hospitality powerhouses, Graspa Group and Ariete Hospitality Group, Da Angelino Cucina Italiana brings Italian tradition to life. More than a restaurant, Da Angelino is a love letter to Italy, offering house-made pasta, freshly prepared meats and seafood and thoughtfully curated wines from Italy and beyond. Located inside CocoWalk in Coconut Grove, the space blends upscale elegance with Italian charm, featuring crisp white linen tablecloths, warm terra-cotta and sage tones, and a garden-style patio for alfresco dining. Guided by and named for Florence-born hospitality veteran Angelo Kometa, Da Angelino captures the warmth and convivial spirit of Italian family gatherings with a touch of Miami charm.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: $40 lunch is available Monday through Friday. $50 dinner is offered Sunday through Saturday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Highlights from lunch include melanzane impanate alla parmigiana (a breaded sliced eggplant dish), penne with a creamy shrimp sauce, skirt steak and seared salmon. At dinner, order the yellowfin tuna tartare, braised short ribs and mashed potatoes or seared sea bream. Desserts feature tiramisu or crispy millegolie al pistachio with fresh berries.

restaurants.description: A sister restaurant to the MICHELIN Guide-recommended Daniel’s, A Florida Steakhouse in Fort Lauderdale, Daniel’s Miami brings GIOIA Hospitality’s signature blend of exceptional cuisine, world-class wine, and refined hospitality to one of South Florida’s most iconic destinations. The menu showcases an elevated steak program featuring premium cuts sourced from renowned producers around the world, complemented by fresh local seafood, classic Italian specialties, and thoughtfully crafted selections for vegetarians and seafood enthusiasts alike. Led by GIOIA Hospitality Founder and CEO Tom Angelo, Managing Director Kassidy Angelo, Culinary Director Danny Ganem, Executive Chef Dayam Lopez, and Wine & Beverage Director Daniel Bishop, the restaurant delivers an exceptional dining experience rooted in European-style hospitality, attention to detail, and personalized service. Guests seeking a more relaxed experience can enjoy the dedicated Daniel’s Bar menu, offering signature dishes, cocktails, and wines in an inviting lounge setting enhanced with televisions and comfortable seating. The space features iconic artwork and sophisticated design elements that create an atmosphere both elegant and welcoming. In addition, guests can look forward to Daniel’s award-winning wine program and celebrated wine dinners, signature experiences that have become hallmarks of the GIOIA Hospitality name.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: The $40 brunch menu is available on Sundays, $40 lunch is offered Tuesday through Friday and the $65 dinner can be experienced Friday and Saturday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Highlights include cobia ceviche, Wagyu empanadas, Florida snapper, heritage burger and braised Wagyu short rib for the lunch menu. For dinner, order the Bar Basil Caesar to start, followed by the Australian Wagyu French dip or Demote Elite Filet Mignon Au Poivre with potato fonduta (+$5) for your main. Desserts include soft serve ice cream, sorbet or coconut flan.

restaurants.description: Delilah Miami is a modern-day supper club that brings a vibrant flair to the heart of Brickell. Elegantly situated with a yacht slip on the waterfront, allure and timeless charm become one at Delilah. This vintage-inspired sanctuary immerses guests in Miami’s sultry spirit set aglow by lavish chandeliers that cast a warm glow upon its plush interior. Within this haven, guests are enveloped in nostalgia by the gentle crackling of the fireplace and the embrace of overstuffed armchairs, elevating comfort while indulging on exquisite American fare. Dining elevates to dancing as a troupe of female entertainers move to the sounds of a live jazz band. Eating, drinking, and dancing blur while guests relish in lounge-style bottle service deep into the rhythm of the night…oh yeah.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: Enjoy live music under Delilah’s massive chandeliers while partaking in the $65 Miami Spice dinner menu, available Tuesday through Saturday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Entrées range from a classic burger on a potato bun to branzino with olive tapenade, fennel and fava beans. For dessert, the restaurant is serving up its famed Kendall’s Slutty Brownie, layered with Oreo cookie, chocolate chip cookie and brownie and finished with vanilla ice cream and chocolate fudge.

restaurants.description: Located in Miami's vibrant Wynwood neighborhood, dōma Wynwood offers an elevated take on modern Italian cuisine in an artistic setting. Helmed by Chef Davide Porcaccio, the kitchen celebrates authentic flavors with a contemporary edge—crafting standout dishes like Tagliolini al Tartufo Nero, sea salt–crusted Branzino served tableside, and house-made Pistachio Gelato. The ambiance is chic and elegant, blending refined design with Wynwood's creative energy. Perfect for date nights, special occasions, or simply indulging your love for Italian food and fine wine, dōma provides a warm, upscale experience. Wine lovers will appreciate the curated list of Italian and global vintages, thoughtfully paired with each dish. Signature cocktails—like the velvety espresso martini—add a stylish finish. Whether dining inside among modern art or relaxing on the serene patio, dōma delivers unforgettable cuisine and exceptional service in Miami.

restaurants.description: DOYA is a modern Aegean Meze + Bar restaurant, located in the heart of Wynwood. Inspired by the Grecian and Turkish Meze culture, DOYA embraces the principle that food tastes better when shared with people you love. Doya's meat and vegetable dishes are prepared over wood fire and coals with flavors from the greater Mediterranean region and the Middle East. Recently awarded a Michelin Bob Gourmand, DOYA's menu features a flavorful selection of cold and hot meze dishes prepared from ingredients that are seasonal and of the highest quality. Doya is open 7 days a week serving lunch and dinner. Guests have the option of dining indoors where the restaurant's extensive bar is located or outdoor in the lush, garden area.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: $40 Miami Spice lunch all week.$65 dinner menu all week.$95 Reserve menu available throughout the week.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Lunch is a great entry point to enjoy shareable hot and cold mezze plates and wood-fired meats inside one of the best restaurants in Wynwood. Dinner leans into that same spirit with grilled octopus and truffle orzo. Don’t even think about skipping the beloved baklava for dessert. For something more intimate, DOYA’s Reserve experience puts you at chef Erhan Kostepen’s table for a multi-course, family-style meal. Savor cold and hot dishes arriving in succession, with three desserts and two cocktails per person. Taste classic and creative hand rolls like tuna avocado and more at Nami Nori.

Founded by Chef Raheem Sealey, the restaurant began as a popular pop-up before becoming a neighborhood favorite known for expertly smoked brisket, ribs, pulled pork and house-made sausages, paired with creative island-inspired sides and award-winning sauces. The casual, walk-in-only smokehouse offers a welcoming atmosphere for locals and visitors alike, making it a great stop for lunch or dinner after exploring Coconut Grove. Whether you're craving tender smoked meats, comforting barbecue classics or a uniquely Miami take on traditional BBQ, Drinking Pig BBQ delivers an unforgettable dining experience.

Specializing in Peruvian Nikkei cuisine, the restaurant showcases the evolution of Peru's celebrated gastronomy through fresh ceviches, tiraditos, sushi, grilled seafood and premium meats, all crafted with high-quality ingredients and bold, balanced flavors. restaurants.description: Experience an authentic taste of Italy's 20 unique regions at Eataly Aventura. With sit-down restaurants, quick-service counters, and a marketplace full of Italian favorites, there are plenty of ways to "eat, shop, and learn." At Eataly's signature restaurant La Pizza & La Pasta, two of Italy's most beloved exports are the stars of the menu: artisanal pasta dishes and traditional Neapolitan pizza. Complemented by an ever-changing selection of seasonal specialties, La Pizza & La Pasta will transport you to Italy with every bite.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: The $40 lunch menu and the $50 dinner menu are both offered Monday through Friday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: For lunch, start with the bruschetta al pomodoro e stracciatella or burrata to start, followed by any of the rich pastas: bucatini cacio e pepe, gnocchi alla sorrentina, tagliatelle alla bolognese or the seafood-forward linguine allo scoglio. Dinner adds dishes like prosciutto e melone and grotto di gamberi e zucchini (a mix of fried shrimp and zucchini), plus even more pastas, including a lobster-laced linguine all’astice.

restaurants.description: Located in South Beach’s South of Fifth neighborhood, Estiatorio Milos is renowned for excellent fish and seafood and a refined approach to Greek cuisine. The fresh seafood selection is shipped daily from the Mediterranean. The menu offerings include Greek ceviche, grilled octopus, and Greek favorites like skordalia, grilled vegetables, and hummus. If you’re not in the mood for seafood, there are other options like ribeye, filet mignon and lamb. Impeccable service, convivial family-style sharing and exciting tableside food preparation provide an unforgettable and truly exceptional dining experience. For reservations, call the restaurant directly at (305) 604-6800. Lunch is served daily from 12 pm to 3 pm. Dinner is served Sunday to Thursday from 5:30 - 10 p.m., and Friday - Saturday from 5:30 - 10:30 p.m. Visit estiatoriomilos.com for menus and more information.

Our Dinner Menu has something to offer everyone in your party from seven different steak cuts to best-in-class seafood and plant-based options. Looking to host a private event or business meeting in our restaurant or at a different location? Our Events & Catering Menu offers a wide selection of hors d'oeuvres, starters, multi-course lunches and dinners as well as wine and beverage selections. For private dining events hosted in restaurant, our Events & Catering Associate will help you select one of our private dining rooms to accommodate your Guest list and coordinate all the details to ensure it’s a perfect occasion.

restaurants.description: This authentic Brazilian Steakhouse (Churrascaria) has been setting the standard in Brazil for the past 35 years. The menu includes delectable cuts of fire-roasted meats such as sizzling steaks, lamb, chicken and pork carved tableside by Brazilian trained gaucho chefs that prepare and cook each cut. Meat is not the only offering of this Brazilian eatery, as you can also enjoy a gourmet salad and sides bar consisting of salads, fresh-cut vegetables, cured meats, smoked salmon and imported cheeses, as well as a variety of traditional Brazilian side dishes such as world-famous such as pao de queijo (warm cheese bread).To enhance your dining experience, enjoy a glass of wine from the award-winning wine list.

restaurants.description: Fogo de Chao is Downtown Dadeland’s authentic Brazilian Steakhouse experience. The restaurant features an open churrasco grill giving guests a 360 degree view of gaucho chefs demonstrating the culinary art of churrasco as they butcher, prepare and grill high-quality cuts of protein over an open flame. restaurants.description: Ghee Indian Kitchen redefined Indian dining in South Florida when it opened in Miami’s Dadeland neighborhood and went on to earn MICHELIN Bib Gourmand Awards in 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025. The restaurant strives to incorporate fresh produce from Chef Niven’s Rancho Patel and has become renowned for its welcoming hospitality and high-energy dining. It enchants both South Asian guests, who seek the authentic flavors of home, as well as locals and visitors seeking a bit of a culinary adventure. Ghee Indian Kitchen puts seasonal and contemporary spins on traditional fare. Ghee means “pure” and has a symbolic meaning both spiritually and in the kitchen of an Indian home. Ingredient driven using local artisan purveyors, the restaurant encompasses traditional Indian home cooking.

restaurants.description: Gyu-Kaku, meaning “Horn of the Bull” in Japanese, provides the authentic Japanese yakiniku (grilled barbecue) dining experience where customers share premium cooked meats over a flaming grill, while sipping on Japanese sake, shochu, and frosty cold beers. We offer a wide variety small plate dishes and appetizers in addition to barbecue meats such as our best-seller Harami Skirt Steak in Miso Marinade and Prime Kalbi Short Ribs in Tare Sweet Soy Marinade. You can't help it - with a personal grill installed at every table, everyone instantly becomes an expert cook. Spending time with friends and family is what Gyu-Kaku is all about. The sounds around you are of parties and laughter - the PERFECT choice for first dates, family occasions, and catching up with friends.

restaurants.description: Located on Ocean Drive, Havana 1957 creates a unique dining experience that allows you relive the glory and glamour of Old Cuba during the 1950s. Find authentic Cuban cuisine, live Cuban music, and vintage memorabilia in the main dining room. If you prefer to do some people-watching, the outside patio will not disappoint. The menu offers a variety of Cuban favorites, like croquetas, media noche sandwich, picadillo and grilled grouper. Wash it down with a traditional mojito, and finish everything off with a shot of Cuban espresso. Make your reservation online or call 305-515-0723 Hours are Sunday to Thursday from 9 a.m. to 1 a.m., Friday and Saturday till 2 a.m. This restaurant also serves breakfast. Check out our website to learn about special holiday menus, like the New Year’s Eve Gala.

restaurants.description: Ichimi Ramen & Bar is a Japanese ramen restaurant located in Midtown Miami, dedicated to authentic craftsmanship and bold, refined flavors. Our signature broths are carefully slow-simmered for 18 hours using natural chicken and pork bones to achieve depth and richness, complemented by hand-crafted noodles made from our exclusive recipe. At Ichimi, we blend traditional Japanese culinary techniques with a warm, welcoming atmosphere to create a memorable dining experience for locals and visitors alike. We proudly serve the Miami community with high-quality ingredients, attentive hospitality, and a genuine passion for sharing the art and culture of Japanese ramen.

restaurants.description: Jacinta de México is a soulful tribute to the strength of Mexican women and the ancestral culinary traditions rooted in their homes and communities. That vision comes to life through an uncompromising commitment to authenticity, including the use of nixtamalization, a 4,000-year-old Aztec process used to craft hand-pressed tortillas from organic criollo corn each day. Set within a vibrant, Tulum-inspired space filled with natural wood and greenery, Jacinta invites guests to explore a menu that spans time and tradition, from celebrated delicacies to botanical-forward cocktails, offering a chance to experience Mexican history one flavorful bite at a time. Jacinta de México is located at 19501 Biscayne Blvd. in Aventura Mall near Bloomingdale’s. For more information, visit https://jacintarestaurant.com/.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: The $40 lunch and $65 dinner menus are available seven days a week throughout Miami Spice.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Lunch includes smoked salmon tostadas, ribeye tacos, slow-braised brisket mole almendrado and green crab enchiladas. Dinner offers Gulf shrimp tostadas, duck confit sopecitos, Chilean sea bass a la Veracruzana, grilled carne asada and lamb meatballs al pastor. The perfect closers: boozy flan al Carajillo, cheesecake with Mexican chocolate sauce and churros with caramel sauce and cinnamon ice cream. Treat yourself to a world of flavor at Reunion Ktchn Bar.

Since opening in the heart of Coconut Grove in 2005, Chef Oscar del Rivero has drawn inspiration from the rich culinary traditions of Mexico, Peru, Argentina, Chile, Venezuela, Cuba, and beyond, creating a menu that is both rooted in heritage and thoughtfully modern. From chef-curated lunches and weekend brunch to Hora Jaguar, handcrafted cocktails, and customizable dining experiences, every dish is crafted with intention to celebrate the diversity and warmth of Latin American culture. More than a restaurant, Jaguar is a place where authentic food, genuine hospitality, and meaningful moments bring people together, proudly sharing our roots with Miami's diverse community and guests from around the world.

restaurants.description: Now Open - With its roots deeply embedded in the cultural and gastronomic heritage of Peru, Jarana showcases an approachable yet authentic menu that embodies the spirit of Peruvian cuisine. It offers a unique blend of comfort, joy and culinary exploration. Each location is designed to reflect the lively, festive nature of a traditional Peruvian "Jarana" - a celebration marked by abundant food, soulful music, and spirited libations. The restaurant prides itself on its fusion of traditional Peruvian recipes with global culinary influences, particularly from Japanese, Chinese, and Italian cuisines, creating a dining experience that is both familiar and intriguing. The beverage at Jarana is a cornerstone of the dining experience with a particular emphasis on pisco, Peru's national spirit.

restaurants.editorial_pick: Start with the crispy tuna wantacos (wonton tacos) or classic Peruvian causa casera. Entrees include the Peruvian Pesto Pasta Milanesa, Josper-baked arroz con mariscos (seafood and rice) and lomo saltado “al pobre,” a sautéed beef tenderloin with veggies, rice, a fried egg and sweet plantains. For dessert, choose between the traditional suspiro limeño custard or a delicate milhoja de fresa pastry layered with cream and fresh berries.

restaurants.description: Before the glitz and glamour that has become "SoBe," Joe's Stone Crab Restaurant stood as a spot for true seafood-loving locals and tourists alike. Established in 1913, two years before Miami Beach would even become incorporated, Joe’s has withstood the test of time. Opened as "Joe's Restaurant" by Joe and Jennie Weiss, local seafood was served up on their front porch after being prepared in their kitchen. Move forward to 1920, when a Harvard ichthyologist brought an unknown crustacean to Joe’s. Joe threw the crab into boiling water and, voila! Stone crabs were discovered. They have dominated not only the menu at Joe’s Stone Crab, but have been a Miami staple ever since. Fast-forward more than 100 years and Joe's has held its place as the leader in stone crabs, fresh seafood and, since its partnership with a Florida cattle ranch, outstanding steaks. From the moment you approach the grandeur of the restaurant (it sits on the corner of South Pointe Drive and Washington Avenue, enveloping most of the block), you can see the attention to detail that is prevalent in the atmosphere, which leads to the incredible dining experience you'll enjoy. A lush and peaceful outside patio greets you. If you’d like to stay outside you can relax on Joe's patio, where the full menu is served. A Seafood Dining Adventure As you enter, a hand-carved mahogany bar beckons. Rich brass details accent the dark wood and terrazzo floors that extend into the entire restaurant. Enjoy a hand-crafted cocktail (Key lime martini anyone?) and a bite from the bar menu available any time after 2:30 p.m. Comfy and cozy leather booths adorn one side of the bar and are available for daytime lunch dates or drinks and appetizers during dinner. Whatever you choose, attentive bartenders and cocktail servers are there to help you decide. Joe's prides itself on its outstanding service and this is proven with its staff, some with more than 30 years of experience. If a more formal dining experience is what you're looking for, head to the maître d' stand and get seated in one of the three dining rooms. If you want to be transported back to the early days of Joe's front porch dining experience, ask if you can sit in the "East Wing," the spot where the original house sat until the early 1960s. It's not outdoor dining, but if you close your eyes, you can imagine the crisp ocean breeze that would have been present as Jennie served you back in the day. Dive into Joe's Menu The menu has something for everyone. If stone crabs aren't your thing (we know - it's hard to believe), try one of the many seafood options, steaks or the award-winning fried chicken, which was once endorsed by Paula Deen and is a bargain at $8.85 for half a chicken. Lighter fare includes salads, soups or appetizers. Weekly lunch and dinner specials change every Tuesday, so you'll want to check the website regularly. Remember to save room for dessert. The Key lime pie is not to be missed. Thick, creamy and tart, the filling sits atop a hand-pressed graham cracker delicately balanced with a dollop of fresh whipped cream. Coming in a close second, Joe’s Apple Pie is a fantastic runner-up contender. Layers of sliced apples, perfectly spiced and teeming with sweetness, are topped by a pecan crumble. Have it à la mode if you dare, but you might need a partner to help you finish off this decadent dessert. If you're looking for a quick seafood fix, pick-up is what you need so just head next door to Joe’s Take Away. Stone crabs, signature items and more await. Perfect for a crunch-time meal inside or your picnic basket for the beach, Joe’s Take Away offers daily paninis, soups, specials and menu standards such as tuna bowls, salads, turkey burgers, ceviche, lobster Rueben (a must-try) and a variety of fish sandwiches. Grab a bottle of bubbly as the final accompaniment and you’ve got yourself the ideal beachside feast. When you leave Joe's, don’t despair, Joe’s can come to you! Joe’s Shipping Department ships overnight, Monday to Friday, anywhere in the country. All in all, this legendary Miami Beach restaurant is a must-see if you are visiting or just in the neighborhood, so make sure to stop by and savor what Joe’s has to offer. You’ll be happy you did! By: Lori Kahn | May 21, 2020

restaurants.description: Hidden behind a picturesque pathway encompassed by lush jungle greenery and ambient lighting, sits joia beach, a day-to-night dining destination located in an exclusive enclave on Watson Island. Here, sun-drenched sands, sweeping views of Biscayne Bay and the city skyline, and vibrant pink-hued golden sunsets await. Opened in 2020 and designed by Francois Frossard, Joia beach has been hailed by Condé Nast traveler as one of "the best beaches in Miami." Described as one of the best places in Miami beach for "those craving a slick beach scene away from Miami beach’s masses," Joia beach is Miami's ultimate hidden oasis. Perfect for sunset cocktails, waterfront dinners, and weekend festivities, Joia beach has quickly become renowned as one of the best Miami Beach clubs and restaurants in the Magic City. European inspired bites and platters designed for sharing, handcrafted cocktails, and live djs and entertainment redefine south beach dining and transport you to a place of pure Joia.

restaurants.description: Komodo provides the allure of an ultra-chic environment paired with Pan-Asian cuisine that is second to none. Tucked away in the heart of Brickell’s financial district, this three-story indoor/outdoor restaurant seduces guests with its overstated décor all while providing a secluded escape within the bustling cityscape. The menu transports guests on an Asian adventure, seamlessly fusing classic dishes with new, innovative culinary feats. Using top-quality ingredients, each dish comes together as a work of art; teeming with flavor while maintaining visual appeal. Also noteworthy is Komodo’s handcrafted cocktail menu, available at each of the four expansive bars, including the posh, upstairs space; Komodo Lounge. The ideal space for any occasion, Komodo can accommodate private dining for large groups or intimate dinners. The venue boasts more than 300 seats including a mezzanine level, lush garden, and the venue’s most unique feature; elevated birds’ nests that create an playful treehouse feel perfect for any occasion day or night.

restaurants.description: Savor diverse culinary masterpieces from all over the world and a wide variety of handcrafted cocktails at Korner67. Located in Miami Lakes, Korner 67 serves a full menu of modern tapas style dishes such as truffle mahi tiradito, honey miso chilean sea bass, filet mignon stroganoff and basil pesto shrimp tagliatelli. Other menu items include light bites, breads, salads and desserts. On the cocktail list, guests will find a generous selection of libations from handcrafted cocktails to culinary cocktails and mocktails. Outdoor seating is available. Korner67 also offers a daily happy hour, Monday through Friday from 3 to 6 p.m., and a brunch on the weekend from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.

restaurants.description: KYU a standout in Miami’s eclectic Wynwood district, is known for its unique wood-smoked, wood-grilled Asian concept, KYU earned TIME magazine’s title of “Best Restaurant in Florida” just one year after opening and was named a James Beard Foundation semifinalist for “Best New Restaurant.” With a dynamic atmosphere tucked behind Wynwood’s iconic murals, KYU offers a one-of-a-kind dining experience, whether you're enjoying brunch, lunch, dinner, or happy hour. Guests indulge in bold, inventive dishes made with pristine ingredients and globally inspired flavors, along with craft cocktails and signature desserts. For the best brunch in Miami’s Wynwood neighborhood, KYU is the place to be!

restaurants.reserve_description: Discover the artistry of L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon Miami with this exclusive three-course Signature Dining Experience, available for lunch on Fridays and Saturdays during Miami Spice.
restaurants.description: L'Atelier's name refers to a craftsman’s workshop, emphasizing Chef Robuchon’s hallmark of elevating the simplest of dishes into something extraordinary using pristine ingredients, immaculate technique, and abundant creativity. Chef Robuchon's protégés carry on this culinary philosophy at L'Atelier Miami, with a Modern French menu featuring iconic signature dishes, alongside new, ever-changing seasonal creations utilizing ingredients sourced from top local and regional purveyors.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: $95 Miami Spice Reserve lunch menu: Fridays and Saturdays$155 Miami Spice Reserve dinner menu: Tuesday through Sunday
restaurants.editorial_pick: For lunch, the three-course Chef's Experience features foie gras royale with parmesan foam, heirloom tomato with roasted beet salad and Ibérico pork, finishing with a Black Forest chocolate crémeux with cherries and kirsch Chantilly. If you're splurging on the Reserve dinner, expect a four-course menu featuring a halibut brandade (a silky whipped halibut purée) with leek vinaigrette and serrano chili coulis. Experience MICHELIN-starred French dining at Le Jardinier.

restaurants.description: La Boulangerie Boul’Mich is a French artisanal bakery with a Latin twist concept that has been in existence for over 20 years in Miami. Our concept is simple, you are at home in a relaxed environment amongst friends in a space that combines light, earthly colors and a vintage- industrial style atmosphere.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: Brunch and lunch are $40 and dinner is $50, and all menus are offered seven days per week.
restaurants.editorial_pick: For brunch, there’s turkey avocado toast; pancakes with $1 toppers like Nutella, dulce de leche and pistachio cream; various egg dishes, and decadent French toast or a crispy apple tart to finish. For lunch, savory options include onion soup, tuna tartare and mini crab cakes, along with seafood or ragu fettuccini and a French dip sandwich, plus tres leches or creamy cheesecake for dessert. At dinner, try escargot and clam chowder to begin and teriyaki-orange salmon, lasagna and juicy Entrcôte steak with herb butter as the mains. But save room for chocolate mousse, a brownie à la mode or tiramisu to end the night. Each menu is also accompanied by a complimentary beverage: a mimosa at brunch, an espresso at lunch and a glass of vino at dinner.

restaurants.description: La Boulangerie Boul’Mich is a French artisanal bakery with a Latin twist concept that has been in existence for over 20 years in Miami. Our concept is simple, you are at home in a relaxed environment amongst friends in a space that combines light, earthly colors and a vintage- industrial style atmosphere.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: The $40 brunch and lunch menus are available daily, as are the $50 and $65 dinner menus.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Brunch highlights include a smoked salmon Key West omelette, classic Eggs Benedict and sweet finishes like strawberry French toast, while lunch ranges from tuna tartare and mini crab cakes to seafood fettuccini loaded with shrimp and mussels. Dinner features escargot and sourdough bread bowl clam chowder, as well as Atlantic salmon, steak frites and wild mushroom ravioli, plus indulgent desserts like tiramisu, key lime pie and Nutella marquise. La Boulangerie's Spice offerings include complimentary drink pairings: a mimosa with brunch, espresso with lunch and a glass of wine with the $50 dinner. Savor vibrant Spanish flavors and shareable classics at Bulla Gastrobar.

restaurants.description: Discover a world of flavor at La Brisa, the acclaimed Latin fusion restaurant inside Miccosukee Casino & Resort. Our menu, a vibrant tapestry of seasonal ingredients and global techniques, brings bold Latin American tastes to new heights. Enjoy the energy of our open kitchen from the comfortable dining room or bask in the fresh, breezy ambiance of our outdoor patio, where the unique spirit of the Everglades meets the embrace of Latin hospitality. Join us at La Brisa for an elevated dining experience unlike any other – perfect for celebrations, date nights, or gathering with friends. Executive Chef Giovanni Genao joined Miccosukee Casino & Resort on June 1, 2026, bringing more than 30 years of culinary leadership across South Florida’s luxury hotels, resorts, casinos, and convention operations. With deep experience in high-volume banquets, resort dining, and large-scale culinary systems, Chef Giovanni blends Latin roots with global influences. His approach focuses on elevating food quality, developing people, and creating memorable guest experiences through discipline, creativity, and respect for every ingredient. Mac Metzler, Beverage Manager at Miccosukee Casino & Resort, oversees the property’s beverage programming, including La Brisa and Tempt Lounge. Originally from Mississippi and now based in Miami, he brings a practical, guest-focused approach to cocktail development. For the Miami Spice menu, Mac created a coffee-inspired cocktail selection that reflects Miami’s café culture while complementing the bold Latin flavors of La Brisa.

restaurants.editorial_pick: Roasted octopus with potatoes and lamb skewers with Romesco sauce are highlights from the appetizers. Indulgent mains move from a creamy cavatelli in porcini cream and truffle oil to a catch of the day with a warm tomato, eggplant and fennel salad. Save room for one of four desserts – we’re going for the Mille-Feuille. This layered pastry comes with cardamom-infused cream and tangerine. Savor exquisite seasonal tasting menus in a sophisticated setting at L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon.

A little piece of Spain in the heart of Miami!

restaurants.description: The French word for "gardener," Le Jardinier's cuisine and setting evoke a modern greenhouse in the heart of the Miami Design District. Michelin-starred Chef Alain Verzeroli's menu is focused on utilizing the highest quality vegetables, seasonal ingredients, and fresh herbs, fitting seamlessly into the modern, light-filled interiors designed by award-winning Architect Pierre-Yves Rochon. The refined yet approachable cuisine, atmosphere, and service create a holistic hospitality experience for our guests.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: $40 lunch menu available Tuesday through Sunday.$65 dinner menu available Tuesday through Sunday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: For lunch, start your meal with a watermelon gazpacho, a salad of Boston lettuce tossed with mint, pear and tapioca crackers, or a burrata salad. For your entree, options range from pappardelle pasta in a lemon aioli, trout with crispy new potato, and wagyu pichana with roasted squash. End your meal with a scoop of vegan ice cream and sorbet, a strawberry eclair or a caramel sabayon, a mousse-like custard sauce served with chocolate pudding. Dinner expands the menu with elevated starters like sea bass crudo and goat cheese salad, while entrées add roasted chicken breast and hanger steak to the lineup. Dessert selections remain the same.

restaurants.description: Leonardo is an upscale Italian restaurant on Miami Beach’s Collins Avenue, offering handmade pasta, fresh seafood, and classic Italian dishes. The evening begins as an elegant fine dining dinner with white tablecloth service, curated wines, and craft cocktails then naturally evolves into a late night dining experience with live DJ entertainment, signature cocktails, and bottle service. restaurants.description: Mangrove is a Caribbean restaurant and lounge with soulful sounds and eclectic dishes. Mangrove is a vibrant Caribbean restaurant and lounge tucked away in Downtown Miami, accessible through, sister restaurant, Jrk!. This eclectic spot embodies relaxed sophistication, blending classic Jamaican flavors with modern elevations. The intimate, dimly lit atmosphere is filled with vintage details and tropical speakeasy vibes, complete with a full cocktail menu and vinyl records. As the evening progresses, Mangrove transforms from a dinner spot serving authentic Jamaican staples like whole fried snapper and jerk chicken, to a lively lounge with a bumping playlist. With its warm, inviting staff and immersive experience, Mangrove is a hidden gem that promises a fun and unforgettable night.

restaurants.description: Open-hearth kitchen, garden café, and Fountain Bar, Mayfair Grill is inspired by the wood-fueled, open-fire cuisine of the American Southwest. Our menus highlight local produce and expertly grilled dishes with flavors rooted in the Sonoran Desert from Arizona, Southern California to New Mexico. Create the perfect pairing with a range of wine or agave-based cocktails featuring mezcal, tequila, and raicilla from Guadalajara and Oaxaca. Our open-plan kitchen and bar seamlessly connect to courtyard seating among Mayfair House Hotel and Garden's lush greenery, cascading fountains, and bustling neighborhood beyond — embodying Coconut Grove's quintessential café culture
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: $65 Miami Spice dinner menu is available Tuesday through Saturday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Highlights from the starters include local burrata and grilled octopus. For dessert, it’s a toss-up between carrot cake tres leches and a mini espresso martini.

For more than 30 years this restaurant has served the finest quality food, featuring USDA prime-aged beef, fresh fish and seafood, hand-picked produce, delicious appetizers and elegant desserts. Situated on the historic Miracle Mile in The City Beautiful, Morton’s Coral Gables is surrounded by world-renowned art galleries, boutiques, and international businesses. Total capacity is 267, and group capacity is 66.

restaurants.description: Motek South Beach is where the Mediterranean meets Miami’s most iconic neighborhood. Located in the heart of South Beach, this vibrant, modern Kosher-style bistro offers a menu that’s equal parts traditional and innovative. We offer Israeli, Lebanon, Morocco and Yemen dishes. The menu boasts an All-Day Brunch section with standouts like the Shakshuka, Hummus Shakshuka, and Jerusalem Grilled Cheese; a variety of Hummus options made daily in small batches to preserve freshness; extensive Cold & Hot Mezzes offerings; refreshing Salads; Bowls; Sandwiches, Pitas & Wraps in a variety of proteins; and Burgers including the restaurant’s famed Arayes Burger.

restaurants.description: Mother Wolf honors Rome’s mythological origin story of Remus, Romulus and the Lupa Capitolina. With Rome as the singular inspiration for Mother Wolf, Chef Evan Funke’s rich and soulful cooking echoes themes of shepherds, popes, farmers and artisans with wafer-thin wood fired pizzas, hyper-seasonal antipasti and the exceptional pastas for which Funke is renowned. Many of the Roman classics are featured – Carbonara, all’Amatriciana, alla Gricia, al Burro, Arrabbiata and more.

restaurants.description: At News Cafe, every day begins with a sense of place. A gathering spot to linger over coffee, reconnect with loved ones, and watch Ocean Drive come alive, the iconic restaurant, bar, and newsstand that helped shape South Beach’s revival in the 1980s continues to operate from its original home inside The Tony Hotel at 804 Ocean Drive. Operated by Vida & Estilo Restaurant Group, News Café presents a curated Mediterranean-American menu rooted in nostalgia and designed for all-day enjoyment. Breakfast and daily brunch take center stage from the original Tony’s tomato soup, tuna melt, Aegean-Mediterranean plate, and classic eggs Benedict to indulgent French toast and Piña Colada pancakes layered with grilled pineapple and coconut syrup. It’s a menu that balances comfort and creativity, where truffle fries, a red-wine demi-glazed burger with smoked gouda, and shareable favorites keep the energy flowing from morning espresso to afternoon spritz. As the sun sets, the rhythm shifts. The Nine Edition arrives nightly from 9PM to close, an intentional late-night chapter that feels editorial, not promotional. Light bites. Easy drinks. All $9. Designed as an after-dinner ritual, it invites guests to linger a little longer with refined yet relaxed offerings. Golden, gooey Mozzarella Bites meet a glossy guava and Coca-Cola dip for a nostalgic, Miami-coded twist, while the Frozzie Rossie, a rosé-forward vodka cocktail with grapefruit sparkle, peach softness, and a delicate floral finish — delivers a crisp, modern nightcap. From sunrise brunch to after-hours bites and pours, News Café moves effortlessly through every day part, always fresh, always printed daily.

restaurants.description: Set within the iconic Eden Roc and home to the top ranked Nobu Hotel Miami Beach, Nobu Miami anchors every visit with Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s celebrated new style Japanese cuisine infused with South American flavors. The menu showcases timeless signatures—Black Cod Miso, Rock Shrimp Tempura, Yellowtail Jalapeño —alongside Miami exclusives such as Tai Butter Lettuce and Tenderloin Yuzu Truffle. For a unique multi-course experience, the Omakase menu reveals the kitchen’s most inventive seasonal offerings. Guests are welcomed into a sumptuous yet contemporary setting that flows from a chic lounge to an oceanfront patio and an airy dining room. Gold cherry blossom motifs, softly glowing lanterns, and an ethereal washi paper installation floating above teak tables create an atmosphere that is at once sophisticated and serene—perfectly framing the vibrant flavors that arrive at the table.

This is Noe Sushi Bar: a story told through flavor, tradition, and craftsmanship.

For more than 25 years, the acclaimed restaurant group has been serving signature grilled steaks, house-made empanadas, fresh seafood, handcrafted pastas and an extensive selection of wines and cocktails in a welcoming atmosphere that feels both sophisticated and relaxed. Whether you're enjoying a leisurely lunch, happy hour, weekend brunch or dinner after a day at the beach, Novecento offers something for every occasion. With indoor and outdoor seating, attentive service and a menu rooted in quality ingredients and authentic flavors, it's a favorite among both locals and visitors exploring Key Biscayne.

restaurants.description: Embark on a contemporary fine-dining experience at NUNA at Four Seasons Hotel Miami. Led by Chef Jaime Pesaque, whose flagship restaurant Mayta in Lima was named one of The World’s 50 Best, NUNA offers a refined exploration of Nikkei cuisine—a vibrant fusion of Japanese precision and Peruvian soul. The menu highlights bold, artfully plated dishes such as scallop and octopus ceviche in rocoto leche de tigre, chirashi-style seafood over sushi rice with aji amarillo, and the signature NUNA roll layered with tuna, avocado, and crispy shrimp. Elevated hot offerings include Wagyu and lobster saltado finished with truffled potatoes and duck confit arroz con pato enriched with foie gras and a shoyu-glazed egg yolk. Set high above the Brickell skyline, NUNA invites you to discover a masterful cultural blend in an unforgettable rooftop setting.

restaurants.description: Ocean Social is elevated coastal dining done in classic Miami style. restaurants.description: Osaka, the trailblazer of the Nikkei culinary boom, has been setting the trend in this gastronomic style since its first establishment in 2001. As the original Peruvian concept, Osaka pioneers an extraordinary culinary adventure, seamlessly fusing fresh ingredients, bold spices, and masterful techniques to create a symphony of vibrant flavors. This globally acclaimed restaurant, born at the forefront of the Nikkei movement, continues to shape and define the rich and evolving tapestry of gastronomy. Nestled within Osaka, the dining experience transcends ordinary boundaries. Culinary excellence takes center stage, crafting an exquisite symphony of innovative and high-quality dishes. The bar is a realm of redefined sophistication, where signature cocktails, born from innovative mixology, elevate the unique flavors of Nikkei cuisine, creating a dynamic drinking experience. The architecture serves as a cultural bridge, seamlessly merging Japanese and Peruvian influences, utilizing traditional materials fora visually stunning backdrop. Music adds the final layer, enhancing the atmosphere with an eclectic personality, carefully chosen tunes contributing to a holistic and unforgettable dining journey at Osaka.

restaurants.description: Ossobuco is a modern grilled cuisine. Fire, wood, meat and vegetables are the real stars of our restaurant. Chef and Grill Master Guillermo Eleicegui reflects his experience, creativity and respect for the product in a variety of dishes with influences from around the world. A global cuisine focused on the fines meats, using the best techniques of the open fire, in communion with organic and seasonal vegetables. Ossobuco proposes to value honest cuisine and treat each raw material with respect, bringing authenticity to the table in a relaxed atmosphere, ideal for sharing great moments with friends and family. In our dinning room, the privileged company of the asador joins us lighting the fire, to start the ritual, offering you a unique gastronomic experience. We trust those who are willing to enjoy what we do best: eat and drink well.

restaurants.description: Transporting guests to the avenues of Paris, Pastis Miami design invokes the spirit of the original location in New York City. Special touches, including the iconic curved zinc bar, white subway tiles, and signature red banquettes, are showcased throughout the room. Gold-framed, hand-painted mirrors displaying the daily specials adorn the walls. Unique to Miami is a sprawling outdoor garden and courtyard that allows guests to enjoy the beautiful tropical weather from underneath a stunning enclosed pergola wrapped in black locust. Pastis offers crowd favorites such as Onion Soup; Escargots; a selection of Steak Frites; and the perfectly-made Cheeseburger à l’Américaine. New additions to the menu include French regional specialties like Big Eye Tuna Carpaccio dressed in lemon-leek vinaigrette, and Red Snapper Provençal that bring tastes of the South of France to Florida. Raw bar platters and bread baskets abound. And, bien sûr, what is a night out without bubbles or rose? The list of cocktails, wines, and beer will keep the celebration going all night long.

restaurants.description: Petralunga specializes in delivering gourmet pizza with healthy whole grain dough, a pinch of gold turmeric, high quality ingredients, and a bunch of creativity! Every bite is carefully crafted and made to share like the customer favorite Cacio e Pepe Truffle pizza and Patanegra pizza with burrata stracciatella cheese. Petralunga also specializes in Roman Style Pizza, 16-inch or 12-inch size, thin and crispy. The most loved is the Brusklyn, topped with tomato sauce, garlic oil, pepperoni, stracciatella cheese, basil, hot honey and parmesan flakes. Since 2024 thin gluten-free pizza has also been available. If you’re not in the mood for pizza, the menu draws influence from the coasts of Italy with dishes like whole grilled branzino, octopus alla siciliana, tartare di tonno and pasta dishes with seafood of the day. The menu is designed with wine and cocktail pairings in mind, and Petralunga features over 150 types of tequila in the mixology bar. The environment is elegant, comfy, light and playful and includes a panoramic view of the bay and the marina of North Bay Village. Pets are also welcome. Checkout our website www.petralunga.com for our weekly offers (Pasta Lovers, Tequila Pizza Tuesday, Ladies’ Lychee Martini Night, Wine Lovers and Happy Hour) and link to reserve. We are open Monday to Friday from 5 p.m. and Saturday & Sunday from 1 p.m. Free, easily accessible parking is available, as well as free parking for boats under 45 feet (call to reserve boat spaces). Contacts: +1(305)615-6671; info@petralunga.com Instagram: @petralungamiami

restaurants.description: Pisco y Nazca Ceviche Gastrobar adds a modern twist to traditional Peruvian cuisine. Inspired by Peru's top ceviche eateries, this new Miami restaurant serves up bold-flavored dishes, unique cocktails and a vast selection of local and international beers. The vibrant bar with open kitchen views is the perfect spot for sipping, socializing and savoring crazy good ceviche. Come experience a celebration of good eats and good times for brunch, lunch, and dinner.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: Take advantage of the $40 brunch offered Saturdays and Sundays, a $40 lunch available Monday through Friday and a $50 dinner menu served daily throughout Miami Spice.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Across all three experiences, you'll find many of the dishes that have made the restaurant a local favorite, from tuna tartare tacos, ceviche and huancaína-dressed specialties to hearty entrées like chaufa de mariscos, lomo saltado and pescado a lo macho. Desserts round out the meal with an arroz con leche cheesecake and traditional suspiro. The complimentary pisco sours make it an extra special treat. Treat yourself to a Miami Spice lunch at Taikin Asian Cuisine.

restaurants.description: Immerse yourself into a nostalgic world of opulence, glamour, and pure magnificence for an unforgettable dining experience. Queen Miami Beach breathes new life into the iconic Paris Theater, built in 1945 by famed Art Deco architect Henry Hohauser. The theater has been restored beyond its original glory with over-the-top 21st-century splendor. The nostalgic design emulates opulence and allure, honoring the glam of the past while envisioning the mystique of the future. Executive Chef Mitchell Hesse and Michelin-starred Chef Julien Jouhannaud have meticulously designed an exquisite Japanese Grill menu with the finest ingredients in the world for an unforgettable culinary experience.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: $65 Miami Spice dinner is available Tuesday through Saturday.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Get the hand-cut beef tartare with XO sauce and crisp lettuce wraps and the barbecue miso lamb chops with whipped tofu cream and herb oil. The old Hollywood atmosphere makes any of the three desserts – matcha-raspberry sponge cake, mango-coconut pavlova and chocolate soufflé tart – feel like a grand finale.

Heralded for its lively dinner scene and bustling weekend brunches, R house recently launched a fresh iteration of its culinary concept. The new R House menu is the best of Miami all under one roof. restaurants.description: Reunion Ktchn Bar is made up of three partners, family members, food lovers and culinary enthusiasts. We love to travel and taste flavors from distant parts of the world, bring them home and share it with our friends and family. RKB is a friendly and unpretentious restaurant that wants to take you on a globalized culinary experience with regional specialties, high quality ingredients and bold flavors. A good meal and drink make a difference in a great reunion. Our experienced and passionate team just got here to make this possible.
restaurants.editorial_when_offered: During Miami Spice, the menu options include a $40 brunch on Saturday and Sunday, $40 lunch on Monday and Friday, $50 dinner Sunday through Thursday and $65 dinner menu nightly.
restaurants.editorial_pick: Highlights include feta phyllo fingers with honey, smoked salmon eggs Benedict and a wagyu smash burger for brunch. Lunch favorites range from French escargot and Japanese bluefin tiradito to butter ponzu blue crab sushi and wild mussels in creamy sake sauce. Dinner standouts include short rib bao buns, shrimp basil risotto and slow-cooked pork ribs, with upgraded options like A5 Japanese wagyu tiradito and grilled branzino. For dessert, save room for Greek yogurt with cherries, walnuts and honey or profiteroles with pistachio cream and hot chocolate fudge.

restaurants.description: Combining Miami Beach’s vibrant culture with a chef-driven culinary vision, Rum Room is one of Miami Beach’s best-known spots for locals and visitors to find innovative, seasonally inspired menus in a relaxed, inviting atmosphere. Rum Room is a neighborhood restaurant available to host special events for any occasion. In addition to the main dining room, which seats 48 guests, the waterside terrace can seat up to 50 guests and provides a memorable backdrop overlooking historic Collins Canal. Venu, located adjacent to the main restaurant, accommodates up to 100 guests in an airy yet sophisticated space. Rum Room & Venu is located in one of the oldest public buildings in the heart of Miami Beach on the campus of the Miami Beach Convention Center.

restaurants.description: Scope out the Miami skyline over brunch, lunch or dinner at this iconic Key Biscayne waterfront eatery. Located in Rickenbacker Marina, the Rusty Pelican offers an ambiance of seaside sophistication, spectacular sunset views and a menu of contemporary cuisine with a subtle Latin twist. Dining options include an ample selection of raw bar and seafood entrees like the Chilean sea bass with smoked sweet plantain mash, grilled peppers and mango-papaya salsa. Or if you’re not in the mood for seafood, opt for one of the tempting meat entrees like the tequila marinated organic chicken with sweet corn arepas, white cabbage shishito pepper slaw and homemade mole. Looking forward to a round of cocktails before dinner? Choose from the restaurant’s expansive menu of cocktails, spirits, wine, sake and beer. And during the week, you can enjoy appetizer and drink specials at the Rusty Pelican’s 4pm to 7pm Happy Hour.
